method: Current source-support inventory assembled from the completed 2026-10-29 verification and the two 2026-10-30 source audits after applying 32 corrections. Every source URL was accompanied by read text; URL existence alone was not counted as evidence. Wikipedia consistency is not independent primary-source verification of every event. No LLM API calls were made for the source audit.
normalization: Whitespace normalization; Wikipedia footnote markers and interlanguage widgets are excluded as non-prose. The USGS record fresh-36 is checked as a GeoJSON string.

limitations: Most inherited questions were checked against the actual Wikipedia text. Targeted primary or specific sources resolve identified ambiguities; no blanket independent primary-source investigation of all 145 facts is claimed.
The 28 earlier web checks (18 URLs; 25 direct-HTTP quote matches on 15 URLs) are preserved unchanged in history[0]. Their retrieval dates remain 2026-10-29.

Current direct HTTP checks support 141 quotes on 57 URLs. Fondazione Prada returns 403; prior UEFA timeout, PubMed SSL failure and 1TV 403 remain recorded. All four have separately read web evidence. Access failure is not evidence mismatch.
The fresh-36 URL returns official USGS GeoJSON, not an HTML article. The answer is the literal magnitude in properties.title; consumers must support JSON source retrieval.
fresh-57 remains supported by its Wikipedia text, whose underlying citation points only to a newspaper homepage; independent confirmation is weaker.
Twenty additions cover astronomy, two questions per each of ten articles. They are a small topic-concentrated sample, and questions within a pair are statistically dependent.
Source freshness does not establish a model-without-tools error rate. Benchmark results and API costs are recorded separately.
